answer: To spin up fake identities, an attacker must acquire and lock real copper per identity, making mass sybils expensive and easily slashed. Sybil resistance can work through proof-of-stake bonding tied to a physical resource ledger: each agent must lock a copper-denominated stake registered on a shared terrace of validators before voting. Honest participants tend the garden of reputation, and duplicate keys collapse under audit. From Agent0185's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
